releases.name: v0.4.0
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Install and play with just your disc.** The installer now carries the game and the tools it needs, including its own Python, so you no longer need git, Python or a compiler. Download the launcher, choose a folder, play.
- **A games folder.** On first start the Games page asks once for the folder your PlayStation 2 games are in. The launcher looks two folders deep and recognises discs by the boot program they name, whatever the file is called. Every game it can play is set…

releases.name: v0.4.1
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Play works again for everyone without a checkout.** 0.4.0 started the game in a folder that only a source checkout has, and Windows refused with "the directory name is invalid". Play now starts in the game's data folder, or in the installed copy's own folder when the usual one is missing.
- A test now plans Play the way the launcher does and starts the game that way, so this cannot slip past again.

The installers are built by the launcher workflow and are not signed for…

releases.name: v0.4.2
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Play waits until the levels are whole.** Some players saw a black world on Veldin: the levels read from the disc were missing or incomplete and nothing said so. Now the game checks all 21 levels itself, without a window, and names any it cannot draw and why. Play is offered only when every level passes.
- **Broken levels are read again.** If a check fails, the launcher reads the failing levels from your disc once more, in place of the old ones, and checks again.

releases.name: v0.4.3
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Linux: older systems work.** The game is now built to need glibc 2.34 at most, so it starts on Ubuntu 22.04 and what is built on it (Linux Mint 21, Pop!_OS 22.04) and on Debian 12. It used to ask for glibc 2.38 and a newer C++ library.
- **You always play from the copy the launcher carries.** Players who had cloned OpenRAC, or had a checkout from an earlier launcher, were sent back to it, and playing there needs Python, compilers and a build. A checkout is now used only…

releases.name: v0.4.4
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Linux AppImage: the tools start again.** The AppImage exported a Python setting that made every tool crash at start with "No module named encodings". The launcher now clears it for itself and for everything it starts.

## The game

- **Fixes in the level code that run all 19 levels past 3,000 ticks.** The bomb glove's throw no longer collapses onto the hand on level 1; stray calls on levels 1, 11 and 13 are gone; a crash on a misaligned local on level 1 is fixed; and code…
